pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the plural of "die Schwester"? (1 mark)
   A. die Schwestere
   B. die Schwester
   C. die Schwestern
   D. die Schwesters

2. What does "das Geschenk" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. candle
   B. balloon
   C. present
   D. birthday

3. Which German word or phrase means "Wednesday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Sonntag
   B. der Mittwoch
   C. der Montag
   D. der Dienstag

4. Which German word is the number 20? (1 mark)
   A. zwanzig
   B. zwölf
   C. drei
   D. achtzehn

5. Which safety idea is right for the kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Leave the cooker on when you go out
   B. Keep hot pots and matches away from small children
   C. Block the door
   D. Let children play with matches

6. Which German word means "to learn or study"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. lernen
   B. sprechen
   C. tanzen
   D. lesen

7. What does "der Schnee" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. wind
   B. cloud
   C. snow
   D. thunderstorm

8. How is "ie" pronounced in "Dienstag"? (1 mark)
   A. like oy
   B. like ow
   C. like eye
   D. like ee

9. What number is "vierzehn"? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 9
   C. 14
   D. 12

10. Which German word or phrase means "balloon"? (1 mark)
   A. der Luftballon
   B. das Lied
   C. die Party
   D. das Geschenk

11. Which food group does "der Kohl" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. das Gemüse
   C. das Obst
   D. die Getränke

12. What does "der Mund" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. mouth
   B. face
   C. shoulder
   D. ear

13. Which food group does "die Wassermelone" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Gemüse
   C. das Fleisch
   D. das Obst

14. Which body part do we link with "riechen"? (1 mark)
   A. das Ohr
   B. der Mund
   C. die Nase
   D. der Fuß

15. Where does the comma go in "Meine Oma ist alt aber nett"? (1 mark)
   A. after Oma
   B. before aber
   C. after ist
   D. after nett

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write three sentences about the weather in German. (3 marks)

17. Write the German names of these months: April, May, June. (3 marks)

18. Write these numbers in German: 3, 7, 11. (3 marks)

19. Write these numbers in German: 1, 15, 20. (3 marks)

20. Write three sentences in German that say where things are in your room. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — die Schwestern
   The plural of die Schwester is die Schwestern.

2. C — present
   das Geschenk means present.

3. B — der Mittwoch
   Wednesday in German is der Mittwoch.

4. A — zwanzig
   20 in German is zwanzig.

5. B — Keep hot pots and matches away from small children
   Small children must be kept away from heat and matches.

6. A — lernen
   to learn or study in German is lernen.

7. C — snow
   der Schnee means snow.

8. D — like ee
   The letters ie sound like ee.

9. C — 14
   vierzehn is the number 14.

10. A — der Luftballon
   balloon in German is der Luftballon.

11. B — das Gemüse
   der Kohl belongs to das Gemüse.

12. A — mouth
   der Mund means mouth.

13. D — das Obst
   die Wassermelone belongs to das Obst.

14. C — die Nase
   We smell with the nose.

15. B — before aber
   A comma is written before aber.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: April, Mai, Juni.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: drei, sieben, elf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: eins, fünfzehn, zwanzig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist an der Wand. Der Tisch ist neben dem Bett. Die Tasche ist unter dem Tisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.
